##### Project General Facts

The Damac Hills - The Legends project is a truly exceptional development, boasting trendy contemporary townhouse designs that seamlessly blend with the fantastic amenities on offer. This outstanding project features large backyard garden spaces, perfect for those seeking a serene and natural ambiance. With its impeccable design and luxurious feel, the Damac Hills - The Legends project is the epitome of elegance and sophistication.

The facilities and amenities available at the Damac Hills - The Legends project are simply unparalleled, offering residents an unparalleled level of luxury and convenience. From the lush expanses of the Trump International Golf Club Dubai to the world-class community vibe, every aspect of this project exudes excellence and refinement. The balance between serenity and vibrancy is perfectly achieved, creating a truly unique and captivating living experience.

The Damac Hills - The Legends project features modern finishing with high-quality materials, infusing cosmopolitan luxury with earthen textures to create a gracious and welcoming atmosphere. The semi-furnished homes, complete with wardrobes, are designed to inspire a feeling of home, effortlessly and triumphantly. With fully equipped kitchens and appliances, every detail has been carefully considered to provide the ultimate living experience, where artful living and distinctive styles come together in perfect harmony.


##### Location description and benefits

Damac Hills offers an unparalleled lifestyle set amidst forty-two million square feet of one of Dubai's most prestigious master-planned developments. This serene community is anchored by the breathtaking Trump International Golf Club Dubai and The Park, providing residents with rich greenery and spectacular outdoor spaces at every turn. The neighbourhood hums with its own joyful beat, where sun-dappled days are filled with laughter and yet, serenity is what truly captivates.

Life within Damac Hills is defined by effortless convenience, with everything from gourmet supermarkets like Spinneys and Carrefour to trendy cafes and dining destinations located just moments from home. Families are exceptionally well-catered for, with a complete family care facility offering medical standards second to none, alongside a reputed academic institution with the latest international curricula. Every inch of this master-planned community invokes a profound sense of belonging, where children can connect with nature and residents can pursue wellness through yoga, Pilates, and lush jogging trails.

Exceptional connectivity places the vibrant heart of Dubai within effortless reach, while the tranquil surroundings of Damac Hills offer a peaceful retreat from the urban bustle. Major road networks provide seamless access to the city's most prestigious destinations, ensuring that business and leisure are always perfectly balanced. This distinguished address truly offers the best of both worlds, combining serene suburban luxury with the dynamic allure of a global metropolis.
